note: w5 Starfall Bay by image to 3D: his Astra pictures. Pictures 1 to 8 landmarks (--grid 1x1); 9 to 20 are 2x2 sheets in reading order ("-" = an empty quarter). Cut with sheetcut.py --tol 18 --holes 8 (grey things at --tol 10 --holes 0). Lying flat things (oar, starfish, lifering, surfboard) may come back standing: dewfit --tip.

doc.blurb: a beach and harbour at dusk where the player is as small as a pebble
doc.style: chunky rounded cartoon seaside props with soft bevelled edges, painted wood, sea worn rope, glazed enamel and canvas in clear seaside colours (sandy cream, sea blue, coral red and lighthouse white with a warm sunset gold), soft even light from the upper left, clean simple shapes. Thin parts drawn chunky: thick spokes, poles and ropes, and only a few of them; nets and cages as solid shapes with the pattern painted on.
